_comment: Helldivers 2 locomotion baseline. Units: m, s, m/s, m/s^2, deg/s. Every value is a calibration target (see docs/MOVEMENT.md: how to measure each one against HD2 frame captures). 'medium' armor is the reference; armor classes scale speed and stamina regen exactly like HD2's Speed (550/500/450) and Stamina Regen (125/100/50) ratings.

speeds._note: HD2 has no walk key: full stick/keys = jog. Analog stick below 55% = walk. ADS scales via the weapon's ads.moveMul.

accel._note: The weight lives here, never in input latency. toJog is near-instant (0 to 90% jog in ~0.12 s); jogToSprint is the long, heavy sprint ramp (~0.55 s); sprintStop is the skid when you let go of a sprint (~1.1 m overrun).

turnRates._note: Body yaw rates. Jog keeps the body on the aim (third-person shooter). Sprint carves: the body and velocity turn together at 270 deg/s, so sprint turns are wide arcs. Prone is slow and deliberate.

sprint._note: HD2: sprint drains stamina; at 0 you drop to a jog and can't sprint again until it refills a little. Firing or aiming cancels sprint. Reversing direction is a plant-and-pivot skid, not an instant flip.

stance._note: Transitions take real time and limit movement while they play. Pressing sprint or jump while prone gets you up. A get-up within 1.5 s of a dive landing uses the fast combat get-up.

jump._note: HD2 has no free jump (that's what the Jump Pack is for). This short, heavy hop exists for the Battlefront genre. No coyote time and no jump buffer, because HD2 has no such leniency.

slide._note: Committed, feet-first combat slide from sprint + crouch. Friction ramps from low to high, so the slide carries far and then stops decisively. Steerable at 80 deg/s. Slopes add gravity along the surface. HD2's own slide is the belly slide after a dive (see dive.belly), and both use this model. Slide into prone: the prone key (or a second crouch tap after dropAfter s) drops you flat mid-slide, keeping dropCarry of the speed (a belly slide that ends prone).

dive._note: HD2 dive: a low, fast, committed leap in any direction (no input = forward), belly landing, belly slide, then prone. Out of a sprint you dive the way you face; otherwise the body stays on your aim: inputs past sideAngle dive sideways (land on the side, roll to the belly), past backAngle dive backward (land on your back and keep shooting). Firing is allowed throughout; ADS drops. The i-frames cover most of the airborne part. The arc is higher and longer than HD2's (0.5 s, half a metre up). Diving off a drop: once the fall below it would land at braceAt m/s or harder (about a 2.5 m drop), the body goes limp into a ragdoll braced for it (arms out ahead and down, then both hands for the ground), and the landing costs braceDamage of what it would on your feet.

evade._note: Non-dive evades for classes that live in melee range (a dive to prone would end every sword duel). sidestep: anyone's dodge within threatRange m of an enemy winding up or swinging at them (The Last of Us Part II: a quarter-second duck out of the blow's way, the trunk leaning with it); elsewhere a gunner's dodge is still the dive.

mantle._note: HD2: hold the climb key at a ledge. Vaults keep 85% of your momentum (min 3 m/s); climbs end at a stand. Auto-vault on sprint is off by default (HD2 needs the key).

landing._note: Heavy landings: about 2 m (9.5 m/s) costs a recovery stumble; about 5 m (15 m/s) knocks you down and deals fall damage, as in HD2.

roll._note: A feet slide off a ledge comes down into a forward roll (a parachute landing fall): landing at minImpact m/s or harder (about an 0.8 m drop), the body goes down onto a shoulder, rolls across its back and comes up crouched over `time` s, carrying keep of its speed plus convert of the fall's speed forward (up to maxSpeed), easing to exitSpeed. The roll takes absorb m/s off the landing: no stumble, no knockdown, fall damage only past the knockdown speed plus absorb (a drop of about 7 m). From maxImpact (about 10 m) it can't be rolled out: the body crumples into a ragdoll and takes the whole fall. Landing softer than minImpact, the slide just goes on.

cover._note: Cover (the cover key, T): your back to the face of a wall, barrier or parked car within reach m in front of you that's at least minHeight m tall; from highAt m it's high cover (you stand at it), below that low cover (you crouch behind it). You get to it at up to snapSpeed m/s and shuffle along it at moveSpeed m/s and stop at its ends; within edge m of an end you're at its corner. Aiming or firing brings you out over peekTime s: up over low cover, or out peekOut m past a high corner (halfway along a wall there's nothing to come out to); the gun is up once you're `ready` of the way out, and you go back in when you let go. Out of it: the key again, a dive, sprinting or pushing away from it for leaveHold s, a hop over low cover, or the cover going (blown away, driven off). turn: how far you face along it toward your side.

knockdown._note: Ragdoll-lite: explosions, rams and big shoves throw you, you tumble and slide, then get up (~0.85 s). Prone soldiers need 1.8x the impulse.

stagger._note: Rocked by a hit (MovementController.stagger, HitReactions; Euphoria's stagger, without the physics). One hit taking `fraction` of your health pool, a leg hit taking `buckle` of it (the leg gives way: down on that knee for a moment), or a shove of `impulse` m/s or more that doesn't throw you: you stumble along it at `speed` m/s (by how much it took; a shove's own speed times `shove`) for `time` s, `accel` m/s2 to get going. The gun is off target for the first `gunOff` of it, and you steer again after `control` of it. Rocked again while still stumbling, with `knockOver` m/s between the two, you go over. Killed or downed by a hit that doesn't throw you, you stumble `die.time` s at `die.speed` m/s along it before the knees go.

melee._note: A blow you stay on your feet for (The Last of Us Part II: every hit reels, a man hit is folded over and stumbling, helpless, then he's back): any melee hit with `poise[0]` or more reels you along it (kind 'reel'), harder and longer the more poise it carries, up to `poise[1]`: `speed` m/s for `time` s, the trunk folding over by `fold` radians once the first jolt's past. `knockdown` poise or more (a riposte, a kick from a big man) puts you down instead. Light blows (rifle butts, poise 0) keep their own shove.

ragdoll._note: Full ragdoll (src/physics/Ragdoll.js): blasts within blastRadiusFrac of their radius, critical hits (one hit taking criticalFraction of your health pool, or headFraction to the head), and every down or death throw the body as particles and constraints. Where it lands is where you are. Poses are the rig's joints in body space [right, up, forward] per stance (pelvis, neck, head, hips, knees, ankles, shoulders, elbows, hands; tests keep them in sync with the rig).

drive._note: Muscles (src/physics/RagdollDrive.js; Euphoria / RDR2 the model). gain: how far a full-strength muscle pulls its joint toward the target per tick. tone: starting strength, dead or alive. relax: seconds for a dying body's legs (lower) and trunk (upper) to let go, so it folds at the knees and topples. shock: seconds the hit snaps the body before anything else. clutch: a hand pressed to the wound. catch: going down alive, both hands reach the ground `reach` ahead of the chest, `spread` apart, once the chest is under `height`, the elbows braced (`brace`) so the arms take the weight, until the chest is `down` (m) and still. air: thrown alive, arms windmill and legs pedal (rad/s). brace: falling on purpose (a dive off a drop), the arms go out ahead of the shoulders `reach` along the way it is going and `down` below them, `spread` apart, and the legs hold together, instead of the windmill; the trunk is held out the way it is going (`level`), its nose dipping `dipRate` rad/s up to `dip` rad as it falls, and `steady` of the trunk's and legs' swing about the hips bled off each tick. writhe: alive on the ground, knees draw up in turn for `time` s (`rate` rad/s); settle: then the muscles let go over this long so the body can rest.

downed._note: Downed (data/down.json): a slow wounded crawl. Push toward where you look: you roll onto your belly (rollTime) and crawl that way, head first; pull back: you roll onto your back and scoot away (supineMul as fast), still facing it. Turning is slow. No stance changes, sprint, dive, climb, shooting or abilities.

bodies._note: Soldiers are solid to each other (src/movement/BodyContacts.js). On your feet you're a round body `radius` m across the shoulders by armor class (crouched, crouchExtra wider); lying (prone, a belly slide, a dive, downed, knocked flat, a corpse) a capsule `lying.head` m ahead of the hips and `lying.feet` behind, `lying.radius` thick. Overlapping bodies are pushed apart by mass (`mass` by armor, times `massMul` crouched, prone, at cover, downed, or planted (not trying to move): braced bodies give less) and the speed into each other is taken off both. Walking into someone lying down you step over him (`stepOver`: speedMul while over him, nudged `nudge` of the overlap a tick toward his nearer side). Coming together at `bump.speed` m/s or more is a bump: whoever took `stumble` m/s or more of it stumbles (shove x that), once per `cooldown` s. Pressed `squeeze.after` s into a teammate who isn't moving, you squeeze past for `squeeze.time` s: shoulders turned, the two of you ease to either side (radiusMul as thick) and nobody's shoved along the trench.
